notes.title: Patch Note: Big Update! (v0.883) - Bar Date, Seha, Minimap, QOL ...
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We sincerely apologize for the concern caused by the recent lack of updates.
The lead director spearheading the project was hospitalized due to fainting and a concussion, resulting from accumulated fatigue and stress.

Fortunately, after a period of recovery, the lead director has resumed work with full dedication to the development of the game. Please rest assured regarding future game updates and the completion of Salty Hounds.

[h3]Seha's Story Update[/h3]
[*] Starting today, Seha's story content will be updated sequentially.
We considered delaying the update further to release all content, including the endings, at once. However, to avoid prolonging your wait, we've decided to release content sequentially in short intervals as each part passes its bug checks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956790/e4715f4b2c4154d8543f7b2391ec14e40acbc3c6.png[/img]

[h3]New Major Feature - Character Location Tracking via Mini-Map[/h3]

[*] You can now see the real-time location of each main character on the mini-map. This mini-map will also display the location of scheduled dates (Sundays only).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956790/5ce783939b642ae45498842da1d390138bcf80d3.png[/img]

[h3]New Date Location Added: Bar[/h3]

[*] Along with the currently updated Seha's Affection Level 3 story, you can now also enjoy date content at the Bar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956790/de3f8493ef326fb4ed89b91212ac38de73b7fc7e.png[/img]

[h3]Quality of Life (QOL) Improvements[/h3]

[*] The 'Confirm' button can now also be activated using the Spacebar and Enter keys.
[*] Setting the text display speed to its maximum (100) will now display text instantly without delay, allowing for a smoother gameplay experience.

[h3]Streaming Guidelines[/h3]
[*] For game streaming, please refer to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876460/][u]guidelines on our Steam page[/u][/url].

[h3]Other Update Details:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Story] The deadline for triggering the bad ending has been extended from 30 weeks to 50 weeks.

[*] [QOL] The 'Confirm' button can now also be activated using the Spacebar and Enter keys.
[*] [QOL] Setting the text display speed to its maximum (100) will now display text instantly without delay.

[*] [Event] New Date Location: Bar - Dates at the Bar are now available from Seha's Affection Level 3.
[*] [Event] Added a Bar date with Seha featuring a mini-game. (Dates for other characters will be added sequentially.)
[*] [Event] Added new conversation events at the Haeryang Securities building.
[*] [Event] Increased the probability of special events occurring from the Haeryang Securities magazine.

[*] [Balance] Bar opening hours changed: 6 PM -> 4 PM.
[*] [Optimization] Game Optimization: Performed game optimization to reduce file size and shorten loading times.

[*] [FIX] Fixed a bug where the phone call event in week 7, where Seha asks about your preferred bar, would end abruptly.
[*] [FIX] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze if a phone call was answered after 11 PM.
[*] [FIX] Fixed an error where the '(!)' indicator remained in front of the Shooting Range even after the event had been viewed.
[*] [FIX] Entrance Cursor Bug: Fixed a bug where multiple entrance cursors were displayed simultaneously at locations such as intersections.
[/list]

If you encounter any bugs or issues while playing, please let us know through [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1CdgfoDrAzm_s4EMpsPeEwvdYF0vBfP9sss6v-tr2jfw/]this Google form.[/url]
Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Preview for the Pending Update v0.89
notes.content:
Dear players,

We wanted to share some news about an upcoming update we're working on to improve your gameplay experience of <Salty Hounds>.
Based on the feedback you've provided, we've been focusing on making improvements to the game systems and content.

Here’s a look at what you can expect in the next update:

[list]
[*] Skill Point Balancing: We're adjusting the time it takes to earn skill points.
[*] Easier Access to Date Events: We're making it easier to find hidden events during dates.
[*] New Quests: Expect some new quests to play.
[*] More NPC Interactions: We're adding more ways to interact with NPCs and making hidden dialogue events more accessible.
[*] NPC Favor & Profiles: You'll be able to check your favor level with NPCs and view their profiles.
[*] Other System Improvements / Balance Adjustments: We've made other improvements and adjustments to the game.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956790/66ac6537d23127f041b162a0421df109630d0f2d.png[/img]

Regarding the significant story and ending update, our development team is currently working diligently on it. 
However, due to the nature of <Salty Hounds>, it involves more than just text and images; it also requires in-game scene creation and various system programming tasks. 

Because of this, it will be implemented after the initial system improvement update. 
We appreciate your understanding that the story update will take some additional time.

We'll provide more detailed information in the upcoming update announcement.

We hope you have a relaxing end to the year, and we look forward to seeing you in an improved <Salty Hounds> after the update.

Thank you.

Team Salty Hounds

===

notes.title: Major Update v0.837.11 - Affection LV 2, CG Album Added
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

This update includes various improvements and new content that you have been waiting for. Please check out the main changes below.

[h2]Unlocked Affection Lv 2 and More Events[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]New Lv1 Events for Noru, Taemin, and Junho // Unlocked Level 2:[/b] 
We have added a large number of events for these three characters, and you can now progress to Affection Level 2. Additional conversations and phone content have been added to deepen your relationships with them.

[previewyoutube=ADjEuOVlVaE;full][/previewyoutube]

[*][b]New Affection Level 2 Events for Seha and Jaewon // Improved Event Conditions:[/b] 
Several Affection Level 2 events have been added for Seha (and Jaewon). We have also made it easier for you to find Seha and engage with him by reducing the requirements for many events.

[*][b]Less Requirements for Various Events:[/b] 
The requirements for events such as Junho's protest and Seha's evening escort were rather steep. We've made it easier to find them.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=sTIbsMYdg2Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Added a CG Gallery:[/b] 
You can now revisit collected CGs in the game. Please note that CGs discovered before this update will not be unlocked, so you will need to replay the game from the beginning to view them again.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43956790/c0057a41c1d525b9fd505212db89da57c24afa1f.png[/img]

[*][b]Added Affection Indicators:[/b] 
Now you can directly check the current affection level when you talk to each character. We have also added the affection indicator dialogues to supporting characters. You can now visually confirm the progression of your relationships more easily. We have also added various quality-of-life changes.
[/list]

[h2]Fixed Bugs[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where your improved affection with Junho was not properly reflected.
[*]Corrected several typos and issues for Chinese and English.
[*]Fixed various minor bugs in basic conversations and other events.
[/list]

[h2]Upcoming Update Preview[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Dating:[/b] Characters like Seha and Taemin will be available to date from Affection Level 2 onwards, which will be released soon. With the addition of the dating feature, you will have more fun and romantic interactions with the cast of Salty Hounds.

[*][b]Affection Content Release:[/b] Up until now, due to bug fixes and stabilization efforts, only early-stage events for Affection Level 1 out of a total of 5 levels, on top of some supporting character events and main story events have been available to you. However, we plan to unlock several times more content through continuous updates.
[/list]

We apologize for the delay in the major update that was announced and prepared last April due to some significant issues. Please look forward to the upcoming addition of the dating feature.

Thank you.

notes.title: Update 0.83 is here! (Chinese Support, Additions and Fixes)
notes.content:
Dear players, we have updated Salty Hounds to version 0.83.

This update brings some new content and improvements, including but not limited to:

[list]
[*] Deeper Character Interactions: Characters now have location-specific dialogues when you use the 'talk' option. You can also interact with them in a new way - through the 'touch' option in the chat menu!

[*] Simplified Chinese Support: We're excited to welcome players who speak Simplified Chinese! Please help us polish the translation by reporting any typos you find. (We are already working on a hotfix, addressing the issue of color codes showing up in the dialogue. Thank you for your quick reports.)

[*] Relaxed Work Deadlines: Failing to meet the work progress quota no longer results in a bad ending. Instead, the game will give you a reward when you meet the quota. 

[*] Affection Tracking: Now you can see the state of your relationship with with the new affection level display.

[*] Story Hint: A helpful hint now appears in his chat so you can track down Junho's main story event at the port without you getting lost as much. 
[/list]

Get ready for future updates that will expand upon existing features.
We're constantly working to improve your experience, so stay tuned for more exciting developments!

P.S. We apologize for the slower updates in March due to localization efforts. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Big Patch - Stability Improvement, Intro Rewrite, lots of bugfixes
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Ex_3EC_CD1U;full][/previewyoutube]

Dear players,
Thank you for playing Salty Hounds and supporting us through this important period. With your help, we've been able to find many small oversights and bugs, improving the stability of the game. 

Contents-wise, we have addressed the issue that the prologue was feeling slightly sluggish by completely rewriting and reorganizing the main story events in the early part of the game.

[h1]Major Changes and Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed: Rewrote and reorganized the first main events, accelerating the pace of gameplay in the first weeks.
[*] Fixed: the black screen issue at startup that was occurring for certain combinations of region settings. This problem should be gone now.
[*] Fixed: the rare freezing issue when going from Flower street to Winter street.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed: The issue of the current revenue progress now resets after the checkpoints of the weeks 11 and 21.
[*] Fixed: The flower crafting activity at the flower shop deducting money twice.
[*] Fixed: the grit increase rate for 'browsing the department store' showing the wrong values.
[*] Fixed: the issue of cooking level not going up when cooking at home. Now a message will show each time the cooking count increases. The cooking level will go up when you repeat this same activity for a designated number of times.
[*] Fixed: several minor visual glitches and character animation issues.
[*] Fixed: the roll bonus from your stats not being applied during the work phase. Now all stats are appropriately considered, providing bonuses to your chance to roll a success.

[h1]Gameplay Adjustments:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed: Reduced the length of the call connection sound.
[*] Changed: the ending checkpoints will occur at Monday morning of week 11/21, instead of Friday night, for a more coherent narrative flow.

[/list]
 
[h1]Content Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed: the "drink at the bar" quest which was malfunctioning.
[*] Added: a hint to Junho for where to find him to progress with his story events.
[*] Fixed: the freeze issue after talking to Jaewon when you talk to him in the flower shop.
[*] Fixed: the event with Jaewon handing over documents on Seha's request was occuring too early.
[/list]


[h1]Miscellaneous Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed: The early event with riding the car with a client which now became redundant due to the rewrite.
[*] Changed: The call from the celebrity's manager now happens on a Wednesday.
[*] Changed: The text message from Noru, calling you to the Brunch Cafe, now occurs upon waking up in the morning.
[*] Changed it so that the update announcement pops up at startup regularly.
[/list]




P.S.

notes.title: The REBOOT has Arrived!
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for waiting.
Today, we have finally uploaded the rebooted version of Salty Hounds, which we have been tirelessly developing from scratch over the past six months. We sincerely appreciate the kindness and support you have shown us in these trying times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956790/32ef451ac8c7bb8987dd60f58199e65ffae9fbe6.gif[/img]

[previewyoutube=xPlJ2CFoaBw;full][/previewyoutube]

As explained in the previous announcement, unfortunately, due to fundamental structural issues caused by the previous programmers, the initial release version wasn’t even suitable for patching or expanding. After assessing the situation, we completely discarded the broken original build and developed a brand-new game from scratch that we can now present to you.

Now, using this build as a foundation, we plan to add the remaining contents through rapid updates, aiming towards the completion of the game in the quickest time possible.

We will swiftly add more contents to ensure that you will already enjoy Salty Hounds during Early Access.


[h2]The State of the Reboot[/h2]

In the rebooted ver 0.81, we have significantly improved the core system and overall stability of the game, providing a much more enjoyable gameplay experience. Moving forward, we will continue to add prepared content based on this version, progressing rapidly towards completion. Expect the next content update to arrive in two weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956790/eca48eaed8687a1e2e60ece3b711e8c6a0c128f9.gif[/img]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

You can explore an open-world style city freely, to encounter five romance options, and progress through the story via various events. The story will then conclude with one of multiple romance endings. (Endings are to be added in future updates).



In the game, there are currently a total of 10 male characters to meet and to talk to, including 5 romanceables and 5(+1) supporting characters, each with their own stories to tell. In order to get closer to them, you can engage with them every day, chatting them up, making phone calls, exploring special events hidden throughout the city, and delivering gifts they like.

You set and follow a schedule from Monday to Friday, working and earning money, while enjoying the freedom to move around on Saturdays and Sundays.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956790/4ffc5a6a9e9475cea7470b276df606d59ee4bd20.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improved and New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] A completely revamped weekday phase (with scheduler)
[*] Items, inventory, and a gifting system
[*] A quest list to incentivize you for your achievements
[*] Significantly easier and faster movement and controls
[*] Better minimap: players can now see their current location and instantly teleport for a small fee.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956790/5a0152c3f91d9622f756dfa3607260dc51989e50.jpg[/img]

[h2]Future plans[/h2]
We will keep expanding the contents of the game now that the core system is mostly in place. In general, you can expect more events, dialogues and graphics to be added with each new update.

In the following updates, we will:

[list]
[*] unlock the Affection Level Cap gradually, giving you access to more conversations and events.
[*] unlock the dating part for an immersive romantic experience with the love interests.
[*] add and unlock more special events with stunning illustrations.
[*] add more random events on weekdays and random encounters on weekends.
[*] polish up the game anywhere we can, and remove any bugs we find.
[/list]

Please consider this build as the first Early Access release that we wanted to give you at the initial launch, according to our original development plans. Please enjoy the game at your leisure, and look forward to upcoming content updates. Thank you.

P.S.
You can submit bugs or issues while playing through [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1CdgfoDrAzm_s4EMpsPeEwvdYF0vBfP9sss6v-tr2jfw/]this Google form.[/url]
Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Note 0.76b9
notes.content:

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[list]

[*] Fixed the issue of the skill rank not increasing at the Taekwondo gym

[*] Fixed various bugs at the Brunch Cafe 

[*] Fixed the bugs in the phone calls of Noru and Seha (up to Affection level 3)

[*] Fixed the known bugs in the phone calls of Yujin and Taemin

[*] Fixed the language setting bug when you start the game on the title screen

[*] Fixed the message log

[*] Fixed the font size of the time display during the prologue being to small

[/list]

[h1]
Known Problems[/h1]

notes.title: Important Hotfix Patch Note 0.76b7
notes.content:
This hotfix contains a collection of minor and major fixes all around the game.
It should further increase the stability of the game and reduce many oddities.

We are planning to bring you a major update in the next couple of days, which should finally address the issue of the main NPCs playing hard-to-get and not showing up often enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956790/04bef52068b8b1122fa62154b8ad2e6b104a4944.png[/img]

[h1]NEW CONTENT[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added some new lines to the bartender at the bar.
[*] Talking to the guys via random encounter won't freeze up the game, so there's a little bit more to look forward to. 
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Calling the guys on their phone from your sofa is bugged and locks up the game. If you are going to try this out, please save beforehand! 
We will fix this as a priority task in the next update, since phone calls are an important part of the game.
[*] Junho, Yujin and Seha are not meant to show up as random encounters before their respective 'intro event' or a string of them. If they do show up in this way, it's an unintended behavior. Fixes and content updates in this area will follow shortly in the next days.
[/list]

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the default starting language to English now.
[*] The English version of the Roadmap graphic appears correctly now.
[*] Fixed the game not remembering your language and sound settings. 
[*] Fixed some choices getting saved globally and getting carried over between saves which wasn't intended.
[*] Fixed a character falling through the floor of the restaurant on Sunny Street.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed your energy level not fully recovering after sleep.
[*] Addressed multiple instances of an event playing when you clicked / pressed button too fast, by adding a slight input delay.
[*] Fixed the freezing issue found in certain random encounter events and addressed other minor issues. 
[*] Fixed the player getting stuck in the prosecutor's office. (Still need to keep an eye on this.)
[*] Fixed the freezing issue when you go out of energy and are forced to sleep.
[*] Fixed saving and loading having an effect on your energy level.
[*] Increased the encounter rate of certain NPCs (preliminary solution. to be updated)
[/list]

[h2]Events[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the characters sometimes calling you [name] instead of your custom name.
[*] Fixed the characters not saying good bye and not ending the conversation when you choose the 'chat' option in the random encounter.
[*] Fixed the missing lines in front of the prosecutor's office.
[*] Fixed freezing issues when talking to certain NPCs
[/list]

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the seagulls at the port looking blurry.
[*] Fixed the character animation when interacting with the photo booth at the arcade.
[*] Fixed the texture compression issue of Cedar Street and Lapis Street has been fixed.
[*] Fixed the speech bubble on random encounter characters showing through the standing graphic when they overlap.
[*] Fixed the work phase event at the office not showing the office in the background.
[/list]

[h2]Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the volume of the incoming call buzz SFX.
[*] Re-adjusted the volume of thousands of voiced lines.
[*] Fixed the work phase BGM continuing to play on Friday.
[/list]

[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some English localization issues, like the missing lines in front of the prosecutor's office.
[/list]

We will continue to work out all the things that are holding this game back. 
Thank you for staying for the show. We will not let up.
